answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The sonnet lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the juniper is where a second reviewer recomputes them. What survives to the ember is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, capped per identity per epoch.
